senses.gloss: स- + अभिकाम स- + अभिकाम, adj. loving, Nal. 24, 13.
स- + अभिप्राय स- + अभिप्राय, adj. resolute, Pañc. 122, 13.
स- + अभिमान स- + अभिमान, adj. proud, Rājat. 5, 233.
स- + अभिलाष स- + अभिलाष, adj., f. षा, eager, Dev. 1, 39.
साभिलाष + म् साभिलाष + म्, adv. passionately, Śāk. 33, 13.
स- + अभ्यसूय स- + अभ्यसूय, adj. envious, malicious.
सभ्य- + इतर सभ्य- + इतर, adj. vulgar, Bhartṛ. 3, 57.
सभा- + पति सभा- + पति, m. 1. the president of an assembly. 2. the keeper of a gaming-house.
स-भ्रू-भङ्ग + म् स-भ्रू-भङ्ग + म्, adv. knitting the brows, Śāk. 16, 17.
स- + भय स- + भय, adj. fearful, Pañc. 45, 8. ˚यम्, adv. with fear, Hit. 85, 3, M.M.
स-भार्य स-भार्य, adj. with (his) wife, Rām. 3, 55, 42.
स- + भ्रातृ स- + भ्रातृ or सह-, adj. with a brother, or with brethren, Johns. Sel. 54, 139.
स-भृकुटि- + मुख स-भृकुटि- + मुख, adj. with a frowning face.
स-भद्र-मुस्त स-भद्र-मुस्त, adj. full of Cyperus rotundus (cf. भद्र-मुस्तक), Ṛt. i, 17 (but v. r. सु-भद्र-, containing very auspicious Cyperus rotundus).
सभक्तिकम् स-भक्ति + क + म्, adv. Respectfully, Lass. 41, 9.

सभा सभा, f.
 1. An assembly, Man. 8, 11; council, Rām. 2, 63, 36, Seramp.
 2. A much frequented place, Man. 9, 264.
 3. A court of justice, Man. 8, 12; Pañc. iii. d. 109.
 4. A house.
 5. A palace, Johns. Sel. 94, 57; Rājat. 5, 391.
 --Comp.

सभाज् सभाज्, i. 10 (rather a denomin. derived from a noun, *सभाज्, i. e. स-भज्), Par.
 1. To serve, to worship, Rām. 5, 8, 20.
 2. To honour, to beautify, Utt. Rāmac. 105, 5.
 3. † To exhilarate.
 4. † To show.

सभाजन सभाज् + अन, n.
 1. Courtesy, politeness.
 2. Honour, Mālav. 74, 10 (thanks).

सभासद् सभा-सद्, and सभासद सभा-सद् + अ, m.
 1. An assistant at an assembly, Rām. 2, 5, 24 (सद्); Pañc. i. d. 336 (सद).
 2. A judge, Man. 8, 12 (सद्).
सभास्तार सभास्तार, i. e. सभा-आ-स्तृ + अ, m. An assistant at an assembly, MBh. 2, 1787.
सभिक सभिक, i. e. सभा + इक, m. The keeper of a gaming-house, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 20; Mṛcch. 33, 24.

सभ्य सभ्य, i. e. सभा + य,
 I. adj. []
 1. Relating to an assembly, fit for it, Ragh. 1, 55; polite, Pañc. i. d. 294 (cf. Bhartṛ. 3, 57; सभ्य-इतर, vulgar).
 2. Trusted, faithful.
 II. m.
 1. An assistant at an assembly of scholars, Rājat. 5, 32; of courtiers, 86; of judges, Pañc. 40, 23.
 2. A person of honourable parentage, Bhaṭṭ. 1, 13.
 3. The keeper of a gaming-house.
 4. The servant of a keeper of a gaminghouse (?), Daśak. in Chr. 186, 4.
 --Cf. O.H.G. sibba; A.S. sib, sibbe, ge-sib; Goth. trasti-sibja, adoptatio, ga-sibjôn, reconciliare, un-sibja, iniqua; O.H.G. sibbi, sibbo, ga-sibbo, ga-sibbôt.
सभ्यता सभ्य + ता, f. Politeness.
